Rajiv, I was just chatting with Abigail about how we could incorporate travel photography into Sam's campaign using interactive events and multimedia. Have you thought about including any of your artwork or the themes from Francisco’s web series in that context?
Rajiv Patel

That sounds great, Latoya. I've been thinking about how we can tie Francisco’s web series into my solo show and also integrate it within Sam's campaign message through community workshops and live events. Maybe we could even do a live painting session during one of the episodes to connect more with viewers?
Latoya Williams

That's a fantastic idea, Rajiv! A live painting session could really make it interactive and engaging. We should plan to incorporate that into our upcoming Valentine’s Day activities too, maybe even have a community art project where residents contribute their own pieces.
Rajiv Patel

Absolutely, Latoya! We could also use this as an opportunity to showcase some of your travel photography alongside my paintings. Let’s brainstorm more about how we can bring these elements together for the Valentine’s Day event and beyond.

It would be a wonderful way to celebrate diversity and bring our community together through art. Let’s make sure everyone gets involved, maybe even have Francisco feature some of the event on his web series.
